claims: C1 a Model Spec section that can be overridden at the conversation level is designated by one of the lower authority levels below root

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: the ranking of instruction authority levels: root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority, used to determine which instruction prevails in conflicts

concepts.name: model_spec_section
concepts.gloss: S is a section of the Model Spec document
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'a section in the Model Spec', so a class of such sections is presupposed

concepts.name: conversation_level_overrideable
concepts.gloss: S is a Model Spec section that can be overridden at the conversation level

concepts.name: designated_by_lower_level
concepts.gloss: S is designated by an authority level L that is below root in the authority hierarchy

concepts.name: root_level
concepts.gloss: the root authority level, from which instructions come only from the Model Spec and its detailed policies

ontology.gloss: S is a Model Spec section that can be overridden at the conversation level and is designated by authority level L, which is below root
